s0001.literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on the renxu new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his general-in-chief Jin Ziting to offer congratulations.
s0001.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on the renxu new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his general-in-chief Jin Ziting to offer congratulations.

s0002.literal: On bingyin day the Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat was abolished.
s0002.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Japan expedition branch secretariat was abolished.

s0003.literal: On dingmao day Prince Zhalahu arrived from the army.
s0003.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Zhalahu arrived from the army.

s0004.literal: At that time the imperial son, Prince of Beiping, had troops garrison the land of Alimali to guard against Kaidu.
s0004.idiomatic: At that time the imperial son, Prince of Beiping, had troops garrison Alimali to guard against Kaidu.

s0005.literal: Prince Sheraqi, together with Tuotuo Mier, Qimuhuer, Sariman, and others, plotted to seize the Prince of Beiping and rebel, wishing to link arms through Zhalahu with Kaidu; Kaidu would not agree.
s0005.idiomatic: Prince Sheraqi, together with Tuotuo Mier, Qimuhuer, Sariman, and others, plotted to seize the Prince of Beiping and rebel, hoping to ally through Zhalahu with Kaidu; Kaidu refused.

s0006.literal: Sariman repented, seized Sheraqi and the others, and the Prince of Beiping sent Zhalahu to report it.
s0006.idiomatic: Sariman repented, seized Sheraqi and the others, and the Prince of Beiping sent Zhalahu to report it.

s0007.literal: The sorcerer-subversive Zhang Roundong was executed.
s0007.idiomatic: The sorcerer-subversive Zhang Roundong was executed.

s0008.literal: The Grand Stable Office was established.
s0008.idiomatic: The Grand Stable Office was established.

s0009.literal: Four hundred eight Xinzhou households were assigned to Prince Bomuer.
s0009.idiomatic: 408 Xinzhou households were assigned to Prince Bomuer.

s0010.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage hunted in the near suburbs.
s0010.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage hunted near the capital.

s0011.literal: On dingchou day the king of Goryeo presented four hundred bolts of silk cloth as tribute.
s0011.idiomatic: On dingchou day the king of Goryeo presented 400 bolts of silk cloth as tribute.

s0012.literal: On bingxu day Keshig Naqun, Prince of Xiping, and others were granted eleven thousand five hundred twenty-one ingots of paper currency.
s0012.idiomatic: On bingxu day Keshig Naqun, Prince of Xiping, and others were granted 11,521 ingots of paper currency.

s0013.literal: Second month, on the xinmao new moon, the imperial carriage visited Willow Grove.
s0013.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinmao new moon, the imperial carriage visited Willow Grove.

s0014.literal: Raozhou route intendant Yao Wenlong said Jiangnan revenue could annually supply five hundred thousand ingots of paper currency; an edict made Wenlong Jiangxi Route pacification commissioner, concurrently arranging tea law.
s0014.idiomatic: Raozhou route intendant Yao Wenlong said Jiangnan revenue could supply 500,000 ingots of paper currency annually; an edict made Wenlong Jiangxi Route pacification commissioner and put him in charge of tea law.

s0015.literal: Grand Steward Anige and acting minister of works Naqun were ordered to make and decorate copper wheel instruments, clepsydra, and sundial.
s0015.idiomatic: Grand Steward Anige and acting minister of works Naqun were ordered to make and decorate copper wheel instruments, clepsydra, and sundial.

s0016.literal: An edict ordered the seal of imperial son-in-law Changji reissued.
s0016.idiomatic: An edict ordered the seal of imperial son-in-law Changji reissued.

s0017.literal: The palace city, Imperial Ancestral Temple, and Astronomical Bureau were repaired.
s0017.idiomatic: The palace city, Imperial Ancestral Temple, and Astronomical Bureau were repaired.

s0018.literal: On guisi day fifteen thousand troops and five thousand horses were mobilized to campaign against Yiqibuxie.
s0018.idiomatic: On guisi day 15,000 troops and 5,000 horses were mobilized to campaign against Yiqibuxie.

s0019.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
s0019.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.

s0020.literal: On jiawu day two thousand two hundred deserting troops of Ganzhou presented themselves, stating they wished to bring four thousand nine hundred forty family members back to garrison duty; an edict granted them ten thousand six hundred twenty ingots, four thousand nine hundred forty bolts of cloth, and four thousand nine hundred forty donkeys.
s0020.idiomatic: On jiawu day 2,200 deserting troops of Ganzhou came forward, saying they wished to bring 4,940 family members back to garrison duty; an edict granted them 10,620 ingots, 4,940 bolts of cloth, and 4,940 donkeys.

s0021.literal: Campaigning against Burma was discussed; Da Bu was made right vice censor, Yehan Dejin associate administrator, leading troops on the expedition.
s0021.idiomatic: Campaigning against Burma was discussed; Da Bu was made right vice censor and Yehan Dejin associate administrator to lead troops on the expedition.

s0022.literal: On wuxu day military supplies were issued to commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi at Bie Shibali.
s0022.idiomatic: On wuxu day military supplies were issued to commander-in-chief Qi Gongzhi at Bie Shibali.

s0023.literal: Envoys were sent to Qianshan to build one thousand Jiangnan war vessels.
s0023.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to Qianshan to build 1,000 Jiangnan war vessels.

s0024.literal: On gengzi day Prince Talahai was granted fifty confiscated households but accepted only twelve.
s0024.idiomatic: On gengzi day Prince Talahai was granted 50 confiscated households but accepted only 12.

s0025.literal: Boluohuan's audit found two hundred seventy thousand shi of grain not yet levied; an edict ordered it collected.
s0025.idiomatic: Boluohuan's audit found 270,000 shi of grain not yet levied; an edict ordered it collected.

s0026.literal: On renyin day the Armory Directorate was raised to rank three.
s0026.idiomatic: On renyin day the Armory Directorate was raised to rank three.

s0027.literal: An order directed that when military officers fell in battle, their sons inherit the post; those who died of illness receive an office one rank lower; this was made regulation.
s0027.idiomatic: An order directed that when military officers fell in battle their sons inherit the post, that those who died of illness receive an office one rank lower, and this was made regulation.

s0028.literal: Tiger tallies were granted to stream-cave pacification commissioner Guo Ang and eight others; Zhang Wen and Yan Yixian were also rewarded with one thousand liang of silver each.
s0028.idiomatic: Tiger tallies were granted to stream-cave pacification commissioner Guo Ang and eight others; Zhang Wen and Yan Yixian were also rewarded with 1,000 liang of silver each.

s0029.literal: Nine hundred fifty-three artisan households of Huangwu'er Tahai were taken into government registration.
s0029.idiomatic: 953 artisan households of Huangwu'er Tahai were taken into government registration.

s0030.literal: On yisi day the Guangdong surveillance commission was established.
s0030.idiomatic: On yisi day the Guangdong surveillance commission was established.

s0031.literal: On wushen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
s0031.idiomatic: On wushen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

s0032.literal: On jiyou day redundant officials in the ministries were reduced.
s0032.idiomatic: On jiyou day redundant officials in the ministries were reduced.

s0033.literal: The Shangdu revenue collection supervisor was changed to a revenue collection commission.
s0033.idiomatic: The Shangdu revenue collection supervisor was changed to a revenue collection commission.

s0034.literal: An iron smelting commissionerate was established and the collection commission abolished.
s0034.idiomatic: An iron smelting commissionerate was established and the collection commission abolished.

s0035.literal: Tax bureau officials of the Great Capital were reduced from fourteen to ten.
s0035.idiomatic: Tax bureau officials of the Great Capital were reduced from 14 to 10.

s0036.literal: The Luorosi pacification commission was placed under Yunnan Province; the East Zhe pacification commission was moved to Wenzhou.
s0036.idiomatic: The Luorosi pacification commission was placed under Yunnan Province; the East Zhe pacification commission was moved to Wenzhou.

s0037.literal: Troops were divided to garrison Jiangnan from Guizhou through Jiangyin to Sanhaikou, twenty-eight posts in all.
s0037.idiomatic: Troops were divided to garrison Jiangnan from Guizhou through Jiangyin to Sanhaikou, 28 posts in all.

s0038.literal: On gengxu day six associate administrators including Tang Wudai were stationed at Huangzhou, Jiankang, Jiangling, Chizhou, and Xingguo.
s0038.idiomatic: On gengxu day six associate administrators including Tang Wudai were stationed at Huangzhou, Jiankang, Jiangling, Chizhou, and Xingguo.

s0039.literal: On renzi day an edict mustered Yixi Busi troops and the armies of Bo, Si, and Xu prefectures to campaign against Burma.
s0039.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict mustered Yixi Busi troops and the armies of Bo, Si, and Xu prefectures to campaign against Burma.

s0040.literal: On guichou day Daliangping commander-in-chief Pu Yuangui sent his son Shineng to audience.
s0040.idiomatic: On guichou day Daliangping commander-in-chief Pu Yuangui sent his son Shineng to audience.

s0041.literal: On jiayin day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0041.idiomatic: On jiayin day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

s0042.literal: The prohibition on Han people's military weapons was tightened.
s0042.idiomatic: The prohibition on Han people's military weapons was tightened.

s0043.literal: On dingsi day Zhang Aolü of Anzhou, for forging an edict and falsely using Chancellor Boluo's seal, was executed.
s0043.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhang Aolü of Anzhou, for forging an edict and falsely using Chancellor Boluo's seal, was executed.

s0044.literal: On wuwu day silver notes and clothing in graded amounts were granted to Yunnan envoys and those below Bashiba of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
s0044.idiomatic: On wuwu day silver notes and clothing in graded amounts were granted to Yunnan envoys and those below Bashiba of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

s0046.literal: Third month, on the xinyou new moon, Wumeng people rebelled; an edict ordered Naqun and Qorqas Timish to lead Mongol and newly submitted Han troops to suppress them.
s0046.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou new moon, Wumeng people rebelled; an edict ordered Naqun and Qorqas Timish to lead Mongol and newly submitted Han troops to suppress them.

s0047.literal: Cattle, sheep, and horses were granted to reward the battle merit of Qutuq Dar and others.
s0047.idiomatic: Cattle, sheep, and horses were granted to reward the battle merit of Qutuq Dar and others.

s0048.literal: Yidu qianhu Wang Zhu, because Ahmad had corrupted the state and harmed the people, joined Gao Heshang in a plot to kill him.
s0048.idiomatic: Yidu qianhu Wang Zhu, because Ahmad had corrupted the state and harmed the people, joined Gao Heshang in a plot to kill him.

s0049.literal: On renwu day Wang Zhu, Zhang Yi, and Gao Heshang were executed in the market, all pickled; remaining accomplices were entirely executed.
s0049.idiomatic: On renwu day Wang Zhu, Zhang Yi, and Gao Heshang were executed in the market and their bodies pickled; all remaining accomplices were executed.

s0050.literal: On jiashen day Dejin Telin used his own funds for garrison-farm expenses; Prince Ajiji reported it; an edict compensated him at fair value.
s0050.idiomatic: On jiashen day Dejin Telin used his own funds for garrison-farm expenses; Prince Ajiji reported it; an edict compensated him at fair value.

s0051.literal: On bingxu day hunting by military and civilian officials of Yidu, Dongping, and commanderies along the Huai was forbidden.
s0051.idiomatic: On bingxu day hunting by military and civilian officials of Yidu, Dongping, and commanderies along the Huai was forbidden.

s0052.literal: On wuzi day Tatarbaqani Station was established, supplied annually with gelded horses from Wumeng Amu.
s0052.idiomatic: On wuzi day Tatarbaqani Station was established, supplied annually with gelded horses from Wumeng Amu.

s0053.literal: Beshbaligh protector-general Abishaq was made censor-in-chief, conducting branch censorate affairs.
s0053.idiomatic: Beshbaligh protector-general Abishaq was made censor-in-chief, conducting branch censorate affairs.

s0054.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, an edict ordered Huluhuosun to convene officials of the Central Secretariat and ministries, Censorate, Military Affairs Bureau, Hanlin Academy, and others to deliberate on the revenue Ahmad had managed, first sealing and registering the treasuries.
s0054.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao day, an edict ordered Huluhuosun to convene officials of the Central Secretariat and ministries, Censorate, Military Affairs Bureau, Hanlin Academy, and others to deliberate on the revenue Ahmad had managed, first sealing and registering the treasuries.

s0055.literal: On dingyou day Huluhuosun was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat; right grand councillor Wengjiladai was demoted to capital intendant while still concurrently associated with the Military Affairs Bureau.
s0055.idiomatic: On dingyou day Huluhuosun was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat; right grand councillor Wengjiladai was demoted to capital intendant while still concurrently associated with the Military Affairs Bureau.

s0056.literal: On wuxu day barbarian-suppression commander-in-chief Wanzhedu and others pacified Chen Diaoyan's stronghold and returned; their army was rewarded with paper currency and ordered home to rest.
s0056.idiomatic: On wuxu day barbarian-suppression commander-in-chief Wanzhedu and others pacified Chen Diaoyan's stronghold and returned; their army was rewarded with paper currency and ordered home to rest.

s0057.literal: Yangzhou archers were dispatched to garrison Quanzhou.
s0057.idiomatic: Yangzhou archers were dispatched to garrison Quanzhou.

s0058.literal: Chen Diaoyan's father Wen Gui and his brothers Guilong and Man'an submitted; an order directed them escorted to the capital.
s0058.idiomatic: Chen Diaoyan's father Wen Gui and his brothers Guilong and Man'an submitted; an order directed them escorted to the capital.

s0059.literal: His followers Wu Man and Zhang Fei welcomed the enemy and were executed on the spot.
s0059.idiomatic: His followers Wu Man and Zhang Fei welcomed the enemy and were executed on the spot.

s0060.literal: An edict ordered Dadu patrol troops placed under the capital intendant's office.
s0060.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dadu patrol troops placed under the capital intendant's office.

s0061.literal: On renyin day an exchange treasury was established.
s0061.idiomatic: On renyin day an exchange treasury was established.

s0062.literal: Left vice chancellor Geng Ren and others said: "The darughachis established on princes' and princesses' allotted fiefs are by precedent not transferred, to the people's hardship.
s0062.idiomatic: Left vice chancellor Geng Ren and others said, "The darughachis established on princes' and princesses' allotted fiefs are by precedent not transferred, to the people's hardship.

s0063.literal: Following regular transfer, upon completing a term, replacements should be selected from their original rank; this would be appropriate.
s0063.idiomatic: Following regular transfer, upon completing a term, replacements should be selected from their original rank; this would be appropriate.

s0065.literal: The capital intendant's office was also placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.
s0065.idiomatic: The capital intendant's office was also placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.

s0066.literal: An edict directed that from this year official carts not be levied on the people; they could be built promptly on the Luan River, with grain costs supplied.
s0066.idiomatic: An edict directed that from this year official carts not be levied on the people; they could be built promptly on the Luan River, with grain costs supplied.

s0067.literal: On jiachen day Ganzhou and Zhongxing garrison-farm troops who had deserted returned to Taiyuan; four who resisted orders were executed and those who did not desert were rewarded.
s0067.idiomatic: On jiachen day Ganzhou and Zhongxing garrison-farm troops who had deserted returned to Taiyuan; four who resisted orders were executed and those who did not desert were rewarded.

s0068.literal: On yisi day because Ahmad's household slaves Qutuq Dar and others had long held military authority, Bodun and others were ordered to replace them, still subordinate to the Dadu capital intendant's office.
s0068.idiomatic: On yisi day because Ahmad's household slaves Qutuq Dar and others had long held military authority, Bodun and others were ordered to replace them, still subordinate to the Dadu capital intendant's office.

s0069.literal: The prohibition on fuelwood and charcoal from the Western Hills was relaxed.
s0069.idiomatic: The prohibition on fuelwood and charcoal from the Western Hills was relaxed.

s0070.literal: Because Ahmad's son Husin, left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat, was guiltier than his father, investigation was discussed.
s0070.idiomatic: Because Ahmad's son Husin, left associate of the Jianghuai branch secretariat, was guiltier than his father, investigation was discussed.

s0071.literal: Stabilization treasuries everywhere were audited and warehouse officials cut.
s0071.idiomatic: Stabilization treasuries everywhere were audited and warehouse officials cut.

s0072.literal: Censorate officials said: "Confiscated fines amount to thirty thousand ingots of paper currency, with gold, silver, pearls, jade, and silks commensurate.
s0072.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Confiscated fines amount to 30,000 ingots of paper currency, with gold, silver, pearls, jade, and silks commensurate.

s0073.literal: " An edict directed these retained to supply the impoverished.
s0073.idiomatic: " An edict directed these retained to supply the impoverished.

s0074.literal: On bingwu day the overall army silver seal of Prince Betemür was collected.
s0074.idiomatic: On bingwu day the overall army silver seal of Prince Betemür was collected.

s0075.literal: An edict directed Nestorian Christians receive grain rations by the monk precedent.
s0075.idiomatic: An edict directed Nestorian Christians receive grain rations by the monk precedent.

s0076.literal: On wushen day Ningguo Circuit Taiping County suffered famine; the people gathered bamboo seeds for food; more than three hundred households survived.
s0076.idiomatic: On wushen day Ningguo Circuit Taiping County suffered famine; the people gathered bamboo seeds for food, and more than 300 households survived.

s0077.literal: An edict directed that when envoys returned from missions, if they did not promptly turn in the travel tallies they had been given, or turned them in but officials did not promptly receive them, all were to be punished.
s0077.idiomatic: An edict directed that when envoys returned from missions, if they did not promptly turn in the travel tallies they had been given, or turned them in but officials did not promptly receive them, all were to be punished.

s0078.literal: All documents required memorial approval before the imperial seal could be used.
s0078.idiomatic: All documents required memorial approval before the imperial seal could be used.

s0079.literal: On jiyou day the 《Zizhi Tongjian》 written in Mongol and Uighur script was published.
s0079.idiomatic: On jiyou day the 《Zizhi Tongjian》 written in Mongol and Uighur script was published.

s0080.literal: An edict announced Huluhuosun as right grand councillor to the empire.
s0080.idiomatic: An edict announced Huluhuosun as right grand councillor to the empire.

s0081.literal: On gengxu day the branch censorate said: "Ala Haiya took submitted people as slaves and claimed them as booty from campaigns.
s0081.idiomatic: On gengxu day the branch censorate said, "Ala Haiya took submitted people as slaves and claimed them as booty from campaigns.

s0082.literal: " An order directed submitted people returned to the responsible offices; booty from campaigns registered by quantity and granted to meritorious subjects.
s0082.idiomatic: " An order directed submitted people returned to the responsible offices; booty from campaigns was to be registered by quantity and granted to meritorious subjects.

s0083.literal: Because raising troops to punish overseas states made empire-wide supply heavy, an edict comforted troops and people; all overdue money and grain and official embezzlement were temporarily suspended.
s0083.idiomatic: Because raising troops to punish overseas states made empire-wide supply heavy, an edict comforted troops and people; all overdue money and grain and official embezzlement were temporarily suspended.

s0084.literal: Huai-Meng Route river conservancy director and deputy, one each, were established.
s0084.idiomatic: Huai-Meng Route river conservancy director and deputy, one each, were established.

s0085.literal: Jiangnan powerful families concealing deserters were rounded up.
s0085.idiomatic: Jiangnan powerful families concealing deserters were rounded up.

s0086.literal: On renzi day Jiangnan bureaus' self-issued relay vouchers were abolished.
s0086.idiomatic: On renzi day Jiangnan bureaus' self-issued relay vouchers were abolished.

s0087.literal: On bingchen day an edict directed dismissal of those who gained office by offering wives, daughters, or sisters to Ahmad.
s0087.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict directed dismissal of those who gained office by offering wives, daughters, or sisters to Ahmad.

s0088.literal: Ahmad's seized commoners' fields were returned to their owners;
s0088.idiomatic: Ahmad's seized commoners' fields were returned to their owners;

s0089.literal: those protected by powerful households who paid taxes at those households were still to pay to the government.
s0089.idiomatic: those protected by powerful households who paid taxes at those households were still to pay to the government.

s0090.literal: Beijing pacification commissioner Alawadin had indiscriminately promoted unqualified persons as civilian administrators; an order directed replacement officials selected.
s0090.idiomatic: Beijing pacification commissioner Alawadin had indiscriminately promoted unqualified persons as civilian administrators; an order directed replacement officials selected.

s0091.literal: Establishing salt transport offices to sell salt certificates was discussed; the method benefiting the people was to be chosen and implemented; surveillance commissions were still directed to audit transport office documents.
s0091.idiomatic: Establishing salt transport offices to sell salt certificates was discussed; the method benefiting the people was to be chosen and implemented, and surveillance commissions were still directed to audit transport office documents.

s0092.literal: The law for private moneylending interest was fixed at three percent.
s0092.idiomatic: The law for private moneylending interest was fixed at three percent.

s0093.literal: It was fixed that officials within and without be examined on a three-year cycle; those completing a term were transferred and ranked, those not completing a term were not permitted extraordinary promotion.
s0093.idiomatic: It was fixed that officials within and without be examined on a three-year cycle; those completing a term were transferred and ranked, and those not completing a term were not permitted extraordinary promotion.

s0094.literal: Tibetan monks receiving relay passes too frequently, troubling the people, was forbidden; from now on none were to be granted except by imperial order.
s0094.idiomatic: Tibetan monks receiving relay passes too frequently and troubling the people was forbidden; from now on none were to be granted except by imperial order.

s0095.literal: Fifteen thousand ingots were granted to the Crane Controllers, and their officials in graded amounts.
s0095.idiomatic: 15,000 ingots were granted to the Crane Controllers, and their officials in graded amounts.

s0096.literal: Fifth month, on the jiwei new moon, the Wan'yi Treasury and Nanjing pacification commission were audited.
s0096.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiwei new moon, the Wan'yi Treasury and Nanjing pacification commission were audited.

s0097.literal: Secretariat and ministry officials were purged; seven hundred fourteen of Ahmad's faction were found, thirty-three already dismissed, the remaining five hundred eighty-one all dismissed.
s0097.idiomatic: Secretariat and ministry officials were purged; 714 of Ahmad's faction were found, 33 already dismissed, and the remaining 581 all dismissed.

s0098.literal: Luzhou military commander Li Cong, for accepting bribes from soldiers and letting them return privately, causing wanhu Zhuanan and others to be killed by bandits, was executed.
s0098.idiomatic: Luzhou military commander Li Cong, for accepting bribes from soldiers and letting them return privately, causing wanhu Zhuanan and others to be killed by bandits, was executed.

s0099.literal: Three thousand seven hundred fifty-eight horses, camels, cattle, sheep, and donkeys of Ahmad were registered; Ahmad's crimes were pursued, his coffin opened and his corpse exposed at the outside of the Tongxuan Gate.
s0099.idiomatic: 3,758 horses, camels, cattle, sheep, and donkeys belonging to Ahmad were registered; Ahmad's crimes were pursued, his coffin opened, and his corpse exposed outside the Tongxuan Gate.

s0100.literal: The Nanjing pacification commission and Jiangnan revenue commissionerate were abolished.
s0100.idiomatic: The Nanjing pacification commission and Jiangnan revenue commissionerate were abolished.
